# stackfall board fixture v1
# A tall, uneven stack with scattered single holes, the board state a
# struggling player sees late in a round: heights between rows 6 and 10,
# no complete row, and free spawn cells. The forced T piece spawns above
# the stack, so the review frame shows the piece in flight, its ghost on
# the stack top, and the tall stack itself in one image.
name: tall-stack-ready
description: uneven skyline between rows 6 and 10 with one hole per bottom row; spawn cells free
provenance: hand-built for the T027 design review to capture a tall stack deterministically; independent of any piece sequence
# 22 rows from the hidden row y=-2 down to y=19; '.' is empty and a
# letter I,O,T,S,Z,J,L settles that cell in its piece color.
